summary: Chapters of public-domain audiobooks read aloud in Spanish, segmented into utterances with their transcripts. One row is one such utterance. The vocabulary and sentence length of read literary prose are unlike assistant commands, so a score here does not describe how an engine handles a spoken request. Runs on this corpus are capped at 2,000 clips, drawn with a pinned seed so every fighter is scored on the same ones; a split smaller than the cap is scored in full.
notes: Multilingual LibriSpeech spanish test split — read audiobook speech. English (mls-en-US) is deliberately not registered here: LibriSpeech-family read speech is already well represented in the arena via other en sets.
